purpose: Primary interactive control for triggering actions or rendering an anchor styled as a button via href.
useWhen: Triggering a discrete action such as submit, save, or delete.
Rendering a link that should look and behave like a button by passing href.

avoidWhen.reason: Toggling a binary on or off state — use toggle instead.
Selecting one of a small fixed set of options — use segmented-control instead.
